title: Beast Aware
tagline: NPCs see a werewolf, werebear or Vampire Lord when you transform.
description: Adds a character-profile section when an actor is in werewolf, werebear or Vampire Lord form, describing a beast far too large for any clothing to fit. Pairs with OStim Beast Form 1.1 (any core: OStim_Beast_Form_Merged.esp or OStim_Beast_Form_TWO.esp; Beast Aware is merged into both), which announces shifting in and out of beast form.
author: That Guy (Coronerra)
